'''Ril Bezant''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] psychotherapist who worked at the [[Aurora Medical Facility]] on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. In [[43 ABY]], Bezant was part of [[Lial Sompa]]'s team of doctors that worked to keep [[Tobb Jadak]] alive after his accident in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] space in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
